whatItMustContain.title: What a Sales Receipt Maker Document Must Contain
whatItMustContain.subtitle: Key elements required for valid expense reimbursement, retail accounting, and tax audits.
whatItMustContain.disclaimer: General information, not legal or tax advice. Check your local rules.

items.title: Merchant Business Name & Address
items.description: Clear identification of the seller or store, including physical location and contact phone or email.

items.title: Transaction Date & Receipt Number
items.description: Exact calendar date of payment and a unique sequential receipt number for bookkeeping reconciliation.

items.title: Line-by-Line Item Breakdown
items.description: Specific names of items or services purchased, individual quantities, and unit prices [Verify with official source: tax authority expense reimbursement documentation rules].

items.title: Taxes and Discounts Separated
items.description: Itemized tax rates (such as VAT or state sales tax) and any discounts subtracted from the subtotal.

items.title: Payment Method and Amount Received
items.description: Notation of the payment mode (Cash, Credit Card, Bank Transfer, or UPI) and confirmation of the total amount received.

items.title: Proof of Settlement Stamp
items.description: Official confirmation that the transaction is paid in full with zero remaining balance.

faq.title: Itemized Receipt Maker & Retail Slip FAQs
faq.subtitle: Common questions regarding receipt itemization, tax proofs, and POS formatting.

items.question: What must an itemized sales receipt include to be complete?
items.answer: An itemized sales receipt must include the business name, transaction date, individual product or service descriptions, unit quantities, unit prices, subtotal, taxes, and total paid. Itemization provides buyers with item-level proof of purchase required for warranty claims, business expense reimbursements, and return policies, ensuring full transparency between merchant and consumer.

items.question: Is this receipt maker with items completely free to use?
items.answer: Yes, our itemized receipt generator is 100% free with no monthly subscriptions, usage quotas, or watermark restrictions. You can itemize dozens of products or labor rates, apply individual discounts, calculate multi-rate sales taxes, and export unlimited PDF receipts without signing up for an account or entering credit card details.

items.question: What is the difference between an itemized invoice and an itemized receipt?
items.answer: An itemized invoice details charges requested before payment, whereas an itemized receipt confirms exact products paid for after transaction completion. Invoices establish payment deadlines and credit terms for outstanding balances. Receipts verify immediate settlement, documenting the date, payment channel, and item-by-item breakdown of funds received by the merchant.

items.question: Can I use this tool as a POS receipt maker for retail sales?
items.answer: Yes, our POS receipt maker layout is designed specifically for retail shops, market stalls, and point-of-sale customer transactions. You can add line items swiftly, enter SKU numbers or product titles, apply exact local sales tax percentages, and print standard receipt layouts instantly from counter tablets, desktop computers, or mobile phones.

items.question: Can I add a store logo and custom return policy notes to the receipt?
items.answer: Yes, you can upload a store logo and add custom return terms or warranty policies directly to every itemized sales receipt. The editor lets you configure custom footer notes for return windows, exchange rules, and customer support contact details, producing a professional receipt tailored to your store brand identity.

items.question: Do you store my product catalog, pricing, or customer sales records?
items.answer: No, we never save or upload your itemized product lists, pricing data, or customer transactions to remote servers. All line-item calculations, sales tax summaries, and PDF renders take place locally within your browser private memory. Your sales margins and customer billing records remain entirely confidential and secure.
